encoding: uint8 log(1+density)/log(25), x fastest for GPU; isotropic generated field
model: Pedagogical Zel’dovich density; independent coarse outer realization; not a fitted simulation, complete measured map, or light cone.
display: Continuous volume integration; violet/gold are false-colour density. Soft horizon window and overlapping level-of-detail transitions. Outer grid does not resolve galaxy-scale filaments.
